description:
Add fixed horizontal overhangs to all south-facing windows in the 4StoreyBuilding model to reduce solar heat gain. 

Target all windows located on south-facing exterior walls (Azimuth = 180°) across all three occupied floors (Ground, Middle, Top). 

Configure the overhangs with the following geometry:
- Overhang Depth (Projection): 3.0 ft
- Distance Above Window: 0.5 ft

Do NOT modify windows on East, North, or West orientations.

After applying the shading devices, run the full annual simulation to update the results and save the project.
